title: Godot freezes and CPU temperature/usage ramps up when keyboard is disconnected whilst Godot is open
body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.7.2.stable

I don't particularly want to test this on other versions of Godot because I'm worried it'll damage something, and I just got my computer repaired a few months ago.

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1088) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-14900K (32 threads) - 31.69 GiB memory - WASAPI (96000 Hz, Surround 7.1)

### Issue description

When I disconnect my keyboard and Godot is open, CPU usage and temperature ramps up as Godot goes non-responsive (including being impossible to close). Reconnecting the keyboard does not fix whatever's causing the issue; CPU usage and temperatures remain high until I open task manager and force Godot to close that way.
This problem occurs on a completely new project with no changes (though for replication purposes I set it up with the Compatible renderer).
I do use Godot Launcher to set up and open projects, but the issue specifically seems to be Godot itself; disconnecting my keyboard when only Godot Launcher is open, or nothing else is open, does not cause the problem.



### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new project.
2. Open project in Godot.
3. Disconnect keyboard; observe Godot going non-responsive, CPU temperature rising (loud fans, et cetera).
4. Reconnect keyboard; observe Godot remains non-responsive, CPU remains doing whatever it's doing.
